digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and contributor/agent workflows
propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's real DCO identity, with Joe Oakhart's bot identity appearing only in explicitly automated workflows
The --force flag bypasses all gates including future gates, while ticket-system invariants such as the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable
LLM verification must preserve flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing without accepting semantically empty results as valid review outcomes
Plan review cannot pass as clean when the ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant
ChatGPT-specific guidance must explain safe Rebar usage when the GitHub repository is read-only and native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access is unavailable
